desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence-analyst community is focused on Ukrainian strikes against the Kerch Bridge and Russian retaliation threats, including renewed strikes on Kyiv and fuel restrictions in occupied Crimea. The single most important development is Zelensky’s public defence of the strikes and call for greater Western/Chinese pressure on Moscow ahead of a difficult winter.

## MAIN THREADS

### Kerch Bridge strikes and Russian response
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123502205118435788) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2123498192293490699) report local accounts of air-defence launches and explosions in Kerch, Crimea, plus EU summoning of the Russian envoy over damage to diplomatic sites in Kyiv from overnight Russian strikes.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2123498192293490699) notes Putin vowed a “robust response” and expects continued or intensified Russian strikes on Ukraine in coming days.
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2123498953513783622) highlights re-introduction of gasoline restrictions in occupied Crimea, previously in force May–October.

### Zelensky statements on support and negotiations
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123502006656483573) and [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123491213827264987) quote Zelensky defending strikes on the Kerch Bridge as fair reciprocity, rejecting any territorial surrender, and urging the US, China and “Coalition of the Willing” partners to increase military/diplomatic pressure on Russia.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123499741719695548) adds Zelensky’s remark that post-winter US Congressional changes could shift Washington’s Russia policy.

### Iran oil-tanker breakout plan
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2123493602399514661) reports Iran considering swarming the US blockade with loaded oil tankers (N12 channel).

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2123493602399514661) — Iran planning oil-tanker breakout (unconfirmed).
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2123499741719695548) — Zelensky linking winter support to possible US Congressional shift (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2123498192293490699) — EU will summon Russian envoy over Kyiv diplomatic damage (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for further Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and any Iranian tanker movement. Zelensky’s calls for Chinese economic leverage on Moscow and post-winter US policy shifts are also flagged for follow-up.
